why_a_different_algorithm: Runs 6, 7 and 8 (direct head; bounded residual; bounded residual + 10-critic RLPD ensemble + 3-step) all collapsed a working BC policy once the actor updated, with the entropy defect verified fixed. Two independent critics rated an exploration-scale random perturbation of the BC action exactly equal to BC (chance level). The actor objective's only remaining term was a critic gradient that does not encode which action directions break the grasp. The fix is to remove the critic: learn from the simulator's returns directly.
method: GRPO-style policy optimisation (Shao et al. 2024; SimpleVLA-RL 2025; RLinf embodied PPO) on a ResFiT frozen-base + residual policy (arXiv 2509.19301). Per initial condition, G rollouts with fixed exploration std; per-chunk return-to-go standardised within the group (advantage); PPO clipped surrogate (eps 0.2) on the latent-coefficient Gaussian log-density (per-entry mean), plus a KL anchor to the base policy (zero residual), beta 0.1; approx-KL early stop per epoch (0.02). No critic, no learned entropy temperature.

configuration.policy: frozen BC head (checkpoints/g1_piston_bc_working) + ResidualPolicy R_MAX 0.15, zero-init (H8 verified: equals BC exactly at step 0)
configuration.conditions: TRAIN split of build_reset_suite(seed 20260817); EVAL split never trained on
configuration.checkpoint: every iteration in trainer format; best-by-in-trainer-deterministic-return kept as best.pt
configuration.scorer_of_record: eval_checkpoint.py, n=25 deterministic, fresh process, on best.pt

hypotheses_fixed_in_advance.H4_preservation: scorer-of-record grasp >= 0.87 on best.pt. A critic-free objective has no mechanism to push off-task unless the returns say so.
hypotheses_fixed_in_advance.H11_improvement: scorer-of-record lift or plate exceeds BC's 0.80 on best.pt, OR press > 0. Predicted: lift/plate improve (group variance comes from the contact nondeterminism and exploration; rollouts that lift score ~12-16 vs ~2.4 for grasp-only, a clean signal). Press discovery within 2 hours: prior LOW (not in the data; needs exploration to depress the plunger 28 mm).
hypotheses_fixed_in_advance.H12_no_collapse_mechanism: in-trainer deterministic grasp on the fixed eval prefix must not fall below the in-trainer baseline band (0.76 +/- 0.12) at any iteration. If it does, the critic-free objective also destabilises the policy and the cause must be found in the returns, not assumed.

what_falsifies: H4 failing means returns alone mislead the policy (e.g. reward hacking within v3) and would be reported with the return trajectory. H11 failing with H4 passing means preservation without improvement under this budget.
no_tuning_after_seeing_results: All constants above are fixed now. A change is a new pre-registration.
